world.h: ICC halts probe into alleged crimes by US troops in Afghanistan
world.b: Judges cited significant limits on the prosecution's ability to gather evidence; the prosecutor's office says it has appealed.
world.title: ICC stops probe into alleged crimes by US troops in Afghanistan

world.h: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit
world.b: The leaders will meet next week on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, with nuclear stockpiles on the agenda nine months after New START lapsed.
world.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit in China

world.h: UN watchdog urges Iran to reopen nuclear sites to inspectors
world.b: The IAEA called the lack of information about Iran's nuclear material a proliferation concern needing urgent action, citing an enrichment plant near Isfahan.

world.h: Finland detects strike on Russian warship
world.b: Finland's military said it detected a strike on a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland area, and Ukraine's Security Service reportedly said it carried out the attack.

world.h: Iran says it struck US radar site in Bahrain
world.b: The Revolutionary Guard called the strike a serious warning over what it said were aerial provocations and oil smuggling in the Strait of Hormuz; there was no immediate comment from Washington or Manama.

world.h: Qatar, Turkiye ink defence deal; fighting rages in Yemen
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: Iran war updates: Qatar, Turkiye ink defence deal; fighting rages in Yemen

world.h: Albania says 2027 NATO summit won't be in Tirana
world.b: Albania's prime minister said a summit would come to Tirana in 2028 if held, as NATO weighs ending its annual summits.

national.h: US measles deaths reach 10 this year
national.b: Two more deaths were reported as confirmed cases topped 5,400, more than double last year's total.

national.h: Supreme Court to hear Trump's southern border asylum ban
national.b: The administration wants the justices to overturn lower court rulings that found it illegal to block asylum applications under the order.

national.h: Tanker strikes New Orleans river cruise boat
national.b: The tanker hit the paddlewheel boat American Heritage, carrying 129 passengers, on the Mississippi, partially submerging it as rescues got underway.
national.title: Rescues operations underway in New Orleans after tanker hits river cruise boat

national.h: Duffy blames old tech for four-hour nationwide ground stop
national.b: The FAA's rare ground stop grounded thousands of flights Friday; the transportation secretary said aging switches, routers and copper lines got overloaded.
national.title: Old tech blamed for the ground stop that caused flight chaos: 'It got overloaded'

national.h: Navy quietly fired commanders, drawing pushback from Congress
national.b: Democratic lawmakers say the Navy didn't tell Congress it fired a submarine's entire leadership team after an underwater collision, breaking with its practice of announcing removals.

national.h: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who chastised him
national.b: After a viral rebuke over decorum at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier on Veterans Day, the defense secretary sought to turn the incident into a PR opportunity.

politics.h: GOP attorneys general seek to revive Trump mail voting limits
politics.b: Twelve Republican state attorneys general began appealing a judge's order that blocked a Postal Service plan, aiming at the 2028 election.

politics.h: Court rules US wrongly withheld New York highway funds
politics.b: An appeals panel said the government acted arbitrarily in withholding nearly $74 million over the state's commercial licenses for immigrants.
politics.title: U.S. wrongly withheld New York highway funds over immigrant licenses, appeals court rules

politics.h: Boebert loses House seat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher
politics.b: The former Navy rear admiral won Colorado's 4th District, one of several surprising Republican losses this cycle.
politics.title: GOP Rep. Lauren Boebert of Colorado loses U.S. House seat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher

politics.h: Democrats weigh RFK Jr. impeachment while courting MAHA voters
politics.b: Some top lawmakers have floated impeaching Kennedy, but that could clash with efforts to win over his Make America Healthy Again supporters.

politics.h: Van Hollen to challenge Schumer for majority leader
politics.b: The Maryland senator said midterm voters want change from the status quo and Democrats need new leadership.

politics.h: Trump says he wants to 'get Cuba done' before leaving office
politics.b: Politico reported it was the first time Trump has put a timeline on a possible operation to topple Cuba's government.

international.h: Germany grants spy agencies sweeping new powers
international.b: The reform lets the BND and BfV actively disrupt threats, such as deleting stolen data from an attacker's server, not just gather intelligence.
international.title: German spies granted sweeping new powers

international.h: UK police open sex offence probe into David Walliams
international.b: The Metropolitan Police said it received allegations of non-recent serious sexual offences, separate from misconduct claims reported this week by ITV and The Guardian.
international.title: UK police open sex offence probe into comedian and author David Walliams

international.h: Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu of 'racist' campaign against Arab Israelis
international.b: The opposition leader said Arab citizens faced a campaign of delegitimisation fuelled by the outgoing prime minister after the October 27 election.
international.title: Eisenkot slams Netanyahu’s ‘racist’ campaign against Palestinian Israelis

international.h: Pope Leo draws huge crowds on return to Chiclayo
international.b: About 500,000 people attended Mass near the Peruvian city where he served as bishop, the Vatican estimated, with a million more along his route.
international.title: Pope thanks crowds on emotional return to ‘second home’ in Peru’s Chiclayo

international.h: At least 10 killed in Guinea clashes over gold mining ban
international.b: Protesters blocked a patrol enforcing the ban on artisanal mining in the Siguiri region, and the standoff turned into an exchange of gunfire.
The military said the fighters were killed in Balochistan since November 3, with 43 more killed in separate raids in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

international.h: Building collapse near Nairobi kills six
international.b: The top concrete slab gave way while construction workers were on site in Syokimau, and rescuers kept searching for survivors.

international.h: Turkiye and Qatar sign mutual defence pact
international.b: Erdogan's office said the accord adds a new dimension to relations, though it released no further details.

international.h: Spanish court suspends far-right group Nucleo Nacional
international.b: The ruling follows the arrest of 14 members on suspicion of inciting hatred; police say they seized more than 20 firearms in searches.

international.h: Lebanon asks Syria to hand over suspects in Iraqi ex-MP's killing
international.b: Lebanese prosecutors want two Syrian nationals over the killing of al-Alwani, a critic of Iranian influence in Baghdad; a Lebanese national has been arrested.

business.h: Microsoft says outage was not AI or cyberattack
business.b: The company said the outage of more than 24 hours, which hit Outlook, Teams and Copilot, stemmed from an earlier network capacity upgrade.

business.h: Airline group says high fares may be the new norm
business.b: Asia-Pacific carriers face jet fuel near $180 a barrel, up from about $80 a year ago, and fuel is a third of operating costs.

science.h: Starship reaches orbit despite booster mishap
science.b: The booster ended up in the Gulf of Mexico after an automatic abort, scrapping the first half of SpaceX's double catch attempt, but the spacecraft will try to return to the pad Saturday.
science.title: SpaceX’s Starship soars into orbit after booster malfunction thwarts double catch attempt

science.h: Guterres urges 'immediate and drastic' emissions cuts
science.b: At his final climate summit as UN chief, Guterres said the world must cut fossil fuel emissions now to avert catastrophe.

sports.h: FAA ground stop leaves college football teams scrambling
sports.b: Programs preparing for road games had to look for alternate travel plans after the nationwide halt.
sports.title: College football teams scrambling to find alternate travel plans after FAA lifts ground-stop order

sports.h: Red Sox reportedly sign Jake Bauers for $58 million
sports.b: The NLCS MVP agreed to a four-year deal after hitting 26 homers for the champion Brewers, ESPN reports.

sports.h: Pochettino leaves USMNT for Manchester United
sports.b: He led the US to a Round of 16 finish at the 2026 World Cup, with three wins, the most by a USMNT coach at a World Cup.
The Astros slugger bounced back from an injury-riddled 2025 to hit .316 with 42 homers, leading the majors in average, on-base and slugging.
The Cubs star beat Shohei Ohtani after leading the majors in WAR, runs, home runs and total bases, with 45 homers and 41 steals in all 162 games.

sports.h: Misiorowski and Schlittler win Cy Young awards unanimously
sports.b: Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski (1.80 ERA, 252 strikeouts) and the Yankees' Cam Schlittler (1.95 ERA) swept the NL and AL voting, only the third unanimous pair in MLB history.

local.h: Signal problems halt F and G trains in Friday rush
local.b: The MTA reported no F service between Brooklyn and Manhattan and no G service between Church Avenue and Bedford-Nostrand Avenues.
local.title: F and G lines grind to a halt as signal issues slows Friday night rush

local.h: Ex-jails chief testifies in Adams-era corruption trial
local.b: Former jails chief Molina told the court an adviser pushed him to interview a friend's daughter, who got a conditional job offer.
local.title: Former NYC jails chief testifies about Adams adviser's push to hire friend’s daughter

local.h: Schools to review hiring after aide charged in jogger killing
local.b: The paraprofessional, who has pleaded not guilty, is accused of fatally stabbing a woman on the Shore Parkway Greenway last month.
local.title: NYC schools to review hiring practices after teacher's aide accused of jogger murder

local.h: MTA wants AI cameras to spot people on subway tracks
local.b: The agency plans to spend $5 million to $10 million testing the technology, with an eye to rolling it out across the fleet.
local.title: MTA wants AI cameras on subway trains to spot people on the tracks

local.h: Engineers question approved plans at Flatbush collapse site
local.b: Three structural engineers said they were surprised the buildings department approved excavation plans without extra bracing for the neighboring building.
local.title: Engineers question city-approved plans after Brooklyn building collapse

local.h: Mamdani declines to back Schumer for majority leader
local.b: The mayor said he cares less about who leads Senate Democrats than what they do for the working class.
local.title: Mamdani declines to back fellow New Yorker Schumer as Senate majority leader

local.h: First Code Blue of the winter declared
local.b: The cold weather emergency runs until 8 a.m. Saturday as wind chills near freezing, the first test of the city's expanded outreach plan.
local.title: First Code Blue of the winter season arrives in New York City

local.h: Flatbush collapse fuels anger over pace of development
local.b: Mayor Mamdani says the city is examining 100 other sites tied to the construction companies, as residents say rapid building is displacing longtime neighbors.
local.title: Brooklyn building collapse has residents questioning pace of development

periods.name: Overnight
periods.text: Mostly cloudy, with a steady temperature around 40. Northwest wind around 10 mph.

periods.name: Saturday
periods.text: Partly sunny, with a high near 48. Northwest wind 10 to 15 mph.

periods.name: Saturday Night
periods.text: Partly cloudy, with a steady temperature around 47. West wind around 14 mph.

periods.name: Sunday
periods.text: Sunny, with a high near 49. Northwest wind 13 to 15 mph.

periods.name: Sunday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 43. Northwest wind 8 to 13 mph.
